svg.title: The Middleman Bid Workflow
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-middleman-bid-workflow; chapter number: 1; title: The Middleman Bid Workflow; subtitle: From set-aside filter to priced submission, as Kizzy Parks teaches it; caption: Kizzy Parks rates a priced VA waste-removal small business set-aside at 50% to 55% win odds for a couple hours of monthly oversight, worth $500 to $2,000 a month to the prime. GovClose counters that middlemen write 20 to 50 proposals per win.; assumptions note: Attorney Steve places the limitations-on-subcontracting exemption at the $350,000 simplified acquisition threshold for plain small business set-asides, while Humam cites roughly $250,000. A 100% pass-through on 8(a), HUBZone or SDVOSB set-asides crosses the legal line. GovCon TechLab floated $30,000 when an agency paid months late.; note: Sources - Kizzy Parks (kejmg4Gzuuc, 386MNSeLv9E, 2GThNGqMOJQ, R-2hdJLvKUM), Dr. Wes Fisher (7NhHddZW0kE), J. White - The Federal Code (LWdgQS6TyHg), GovCon TechLab (uYFWvLCSDgA), GovCon Empire with Derrick Green 'Theo' (h72zKiJRBe4), GovClose | DoD Contract Academy (GSss1UvHnQg).; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Filter Small Business Set-Asides; value: Step 1; detail: Filter SAM for small business set-asides and open every attachment, because Parks calls it a game of reading. Check whether 52.219-14 is checked on the solicitation (Dr. Wes Fisher).; step: 02; label: Pull the Prior Contract Amount; value: Step 2; detail: Get the prior award from the point of contact, USA Spending or FPDS so a $120,000 bid never lands against a $40,000 history (Kizzy Parks).; step: 03; label: Collect Three Vendor Quotes; value: Step 3; detail: Three price quotes before opening a Word document. Quote big players such as WM or Republic, not small rivals who will bid the job themselves (Kizzy Parks). Line up a backup sub at the same price (J. White, citing Stephanie).; step: 04; label: Lock Pay-After-Paid Terms; value: Step 4; detail: Ask the vendor whether paying after you have been paid is okay and write a stop-work clause into the service agreement (Kizzy Parks). Prove 60 to 90 days of float through a line of credit or cash reserve (GovCon TechLab).; step: 05; label: Mark Up and Document Management; value: Step 5; detail: Add a 20% to 100% markup (Kizzy Parks), then document oversight with an org chart, defined roles and Gantt charts, because if the paperwork is not right, it did not happen (Derrick Green 'Theo').

rect.title: step: 01; label: Filter Small Business Set-Asides; value: Step 1; detail: Filter SAM for small business set-asides and open every attachment, because Parks calls it a game of reading. Check whether 52.219-14 is checked on the solicitation (Dr. Wes Fisher).

text.title: Filter SAM for small business set-asides and open every attachment, because Parks calls it a game of reading. Check whether 52.219-14 is checked on the solicitation (Dr. Wes Fisher).

rect.title: step: 02; label: Pull the Prior Contract Amount; value: Step 2; detail: Get the prior award from the point of contact, USA Spending or FPDS so a $120,000 bid never lands against a $40,000 history (Kizzy Parks).

text.title: Get the prior award from the point of contact, USA Spending or FPDS so a $120,000 bid never lands against a $40,000 history (Kizzy Parks).

rect.title: step: 03; label: Collect Three Vendor Quotes; value: Step 3; detail: Three price quotes before opening a Word document. Quote big players such as WM or Republic, not small rivals who will bid the job themselves (Kizzy Parks). Line up a backup sub at the same price (J. White, citing Stephanie).

text.title: Three price quotes before opening a Word document. Quote big players such as WM or Republic, not small rivals who will bid the job themselves (Kizzy Parks). Line up a backup sub at the same price (J. White, citing Stephanie).

rect.title: step: 04; label: Lock Pay-After-Paid Terms; value: Step 4; detail: Ask the vendor whether paying after you have been paid is okay and write a stop-work clause into the service agreement (Kizzy Parks). Prove 60 to 90 days of float through a line of credit or cash reserve (GovCon TechLab).

text.title: Ask the vendor whether paying after you have been paid is okay and write a stop-work clause into the service agreement (Kizzy Parks). Prove 60 to 90 days of float through a line of credit or cash reserve (GovCon TechLab).

rect.title: step: 05; label: Mark Up and Document Management; value: Step 5; detail: Add a 20% to 100% markup (Kizzy Parks), then document oversight with an org chart, defined roles and Gantt charts, because if the paperwork is not right, it did not happen (Derrick Green 'Theo').

text.title: Add a 20% to 100% markup (Kizzy Parks), then document oversight with an org chart, defined roles and Gantt charts, because if the paperwork is not right, it did not happen (Derrick Green 'Theo').

Assumptions: Attorney Steve places the limitations-on-subcontracting exemption at the $350,000 simplified acquisition threshold for plain small business set-asides, while Humam cites roughly $250,000. A 100% pass-through on 8(a), HUBZone or SDVOSB set-asides crosses the legal line. GovCon TechLab floated $30,000 when an agency paid months late.
